name: mcp-server-cards
description: MCP Server Cards (SEP-2127) for Claude Code: find the MCP servers a domain publishes, check their Server Cards, and add one with Claude Code's own config and sign-in

disabled.title: Turn the polyfill off
disabled.description: Registers nothing and fetches nothing. Use this once Claude Code supports Server Cards itself.

ard.title: Agentic Resource Discovery (draft) features
ard.description: Off by default. On: also read /.well-known/ard.json and rel="ard" links, and offer registry search (search_mcp_servers). These come from the Agentic Resource Discovery draft, not from the Server Cards spec (SEP-2127). Off: only /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, which SEP-2127 names, and the AI Catalog it relies on.

registry.title: ARD registry for search
registry.description: Base URL of the Agentic Resource Discovery registry that search_mcp_servers asks (it appends /search). The query text is sent there. Empty: search only a registry you name each time.

notice_on_fetch.title: Notice published servers on pages Claude fetches
notice_on_fetch.description: After Claude fetches a page with WebFetch, check that site's catalog and show a line in the transcript if it publishes an MCP server. Only sites Claude already contacted are checked.

picker.title: Show a picker under results
picker.description: Under a discovery or search result, show the servers found with an Add button, so you can add one with a click. Adding by asking Claude works either way.
